summary: Defines RSVP-TE signaling extensions to move a connection between management plane control and GMPLS control plane without disturbing the traffic. This lets permanent connections become soft permanent ones and back. It is a proposed standard.

eli5.summary: You switch who steers a bus from a manager to a driver without stopping the bus or bothering the passengers.

questions: handover from management plane to control plane gmpls
convert permanent connection to soft permanent
